summary.en: A pipeline with you at both ends: the title decodes, nodes land every half beat (the first and last are you, outlined in ink), links light, a bracket names what the machine runs between, and a dot loops back from the last machine step to the first.
summary.zh: 两头都是你的管线：标题解码出现，节点每半拍落下一个（首尾是你，用墨色描边），连线亮起，括号标出中间由机器运行的部分，一个光点从最后一个机器步骤绕回第一个。

fits: The film's point that a person sets the work and signs it off, the machine does the middle.
notFor: Pipelines without a person; more than six steps; a loop that is not a retry.

intent.en: Put the person at the start and the end of the machine's work, visibly.
intent.zh: 让人明明白白地站在机器工作的起点和终点。

content.en: A title in two halves (≤ 5 words), a sub (≤ 6 words), 3–6 nodes (tag, name, sub; the ends marked you), a bracket label, a loop label.
content.zh: 两半的标题（≤ 10 字）、副标（≤ 12 字）、3–6 个节点（标签、名称、说明；首尾标为你）、括号说明、回环说明。

fits.zh: 片子要说的是：人定下工作、人签字收尾，中间交给机器。

notFor.zh: 没有人的管线；超过六步；不是重试的回环。

en: Plakat's human-loop says the same in print; do not use both in one film.
zh: plakat 的 human-loop 用印刷的方式讲同一件事；一部片子里不要两个都用。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
